name: wai-hint-adherence-corrupt-config
provenance: ticket evallerina-ey7 (hint-adherence family, corrupt-config injection). Recorded live against wai 2026.10.5 on 2026-10-09 in a scratch $TMPDIR directory seeded with a malformed .wai/config.toml (`not valid toml [[[`): `wai status --json` exits 1 with error envelope E000 whose data.remediation suggests `wai doctor`; the agent follows the hint (`wai doctor --json`, exit 1 ok:true doctor envelope whose hints include `Fix the syntax in .wai/config.toml`); the agent hand-repairs the config with printf and `wai status --json` recovers with ok:true. Fixture equivalent: the malformed config is materialized via Scenario::fixture_file. Channel note: doctor emits envelope_kind "doctor" with ok:true even though it exits 1 — recovery is asserted on the final status envelope, not doctor's.
